en: Psalms 71

p.src: 1  In you, LORD, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

ja: を見ることのないようにしてください。
en: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.
u.src: 1  In you, LORD, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

p.src: 2  Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

en: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
u.src: 2  Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

p.src: 3  Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

ja: いつでも逃げ込める避け所の岩となってください。
じてください。 あなたは
en: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
u.src: 3  Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

p.src: 4  Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

ja: してください。 不義で残酷な者の手から。
en: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
u.src: 4  Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

p.src: 5  For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.

ja: い頃から、私が信頼してきた方だからだ。
en: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
u.src: 5  For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.

p.src: 6  I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.

ja: から、あなたに頼っていた。 あなたは私を
en: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
u.src: 6  I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.

p.src: 7  I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.

ja: なしるしとなったが、 あなたは
en: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
u.src: 7  I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.

p.src: 8  My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.

en: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.
u.src: 8  My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.

p.src: 9  Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.

ja: を退けないでください。
en: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
u.src: 9  Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.

p.src: 10  For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

en: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,
u.src: 10  For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

p.src: 11  saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”

en: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”
u.src: 11  saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”

p.src: 12  God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

en: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.
u.src: 12  God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

p.src: 13  Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

ja: に害を加えようとする
en: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
u.src: 13  Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

p.src: 14  But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

ja: き、 あなたをますます
en: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
u.src: 14  But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

p.src: 15  My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.

ja: り伝える。 そのすべてを
えきることはできない。
en: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
u.src: 15  My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.

p.src: 16  I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

en: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
u.src: 16  I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

p.src: 17  God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

ja: くべき御業を告げ知らせていた。
en: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
u.src: 17  God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

p.src: 18  Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

ja: てないでください。 あなたの
に、 あなたの力強い御業を、これから
en: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.
u.src: 18  Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

p.src: 19  God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?

ja: は天にまで届く。 あなたは
いなることをなされた。
よ、誰があなたに似ているだろうか。
en: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?
u.src: 19  God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?

p.src: 20  You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

ja: しく厳しい試練を味わわせたが、 私を
び生かしてくださる。 あなたは
en: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
u.src: 20  You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

p.src: 21  Increase my honor and comfort me again.

en: Increase my honor and comfort me again.
u.src: 21  Increase my honor and comfort me again.

p.src: 22  I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

ja: をたたえる。 イスラエルの
に合わせてあなたにほめ
en: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
u.src: 22  I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

p.src: 23  My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

ja: は喜びの声を上げる。 あなたが
も、あなたにほめ歌を歌う。
en: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
u.src: 23  My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

p.src: 24  My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.

ja: について語る。 私に害を加えようとする
en: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.
u.src: 24  My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.
